violations.title: Cooling from 135F to 70F, No More than 2 Hours
violations.observation: The following cooked time/temperature control for safety food(s) are not being adequately cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours. Observed Carnitas (cooked pork) at 114F sitting on Range for more than 3 hr after cooking.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety foods shall be cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours to prevent the growth of harmful bacteria. Foods that have been temperature abused are to be discarded. PIC discarded Carnitas during inspection, education on proper cooling parameters was provided.

out_items.name: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control

violations.title: Methods to Facilitate Proper Cooling
violations.observation: The following methods used for cooling were not adequate to facilitate proper cooling: Observed a large pot of Carnitas (cooked pork) sitting on Range for more than three hours after cooking.
violations.corrective_action: Cooling hot foods shall be accomplished as follows: 1) placing the food in shallow pans; 2) separating the food into smaller or thinner portions; 3) using rapid cooling equipment; 4) stirring the food in a container placed in an ice water bath; 5) using containers that facilitate heat transfer; 6) adding ice as an ingredient; or other effective methods. Food containers placed in cooling and cold equipment to cool shall be: 1) arranged in the equipment to provide maximum heat transfer through the containers walls, and 2) loosely covered or uncovered as long as protected from contamination to facilitate heat transfer from the surface of the food. EHS provided education on proper cooling parameters.

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. OBSERVED NO CFM ONSITE AT TIME OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. PIC UNDERSTANDS A CFM MUST BE ONSITE DURING ALL HOURS OF OPERATION. PLEASE ENSURE CORRECTION BY TIME OF FOLLOW-UP.

violations.observation: The following cooked time/temperature control for safety foods are not being adequately cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours: OBSERVED REFRIED BEANS ON COUNTER-TOP AT 95-118F; OBSERVED COOKED RICE IN TWO-DOOR UPR COOLER AT 76-90F. BOTH FOODS WERE MADE MORE THAN 2 HOURS PRIOR.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety foods shall be cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours to prevent the growth of harmful bacteria. Foods that have been temperature abused are to be discarded. PIC DISCARDED OF FOODS DURING INSPECTION. EDUCATION ON PROPER COOLING PARAMETERS WAS PROVIDED.
